# OpenDesign reference

The K-Digital learning platform uses an independently adapted design informed by nexu-io/open-design, commit 53231d40b778d88eba23f35547bf99485d3ae9fc.

References: design-systems/clean/DESIGN.md, design-systems/mintlify/DESIGN.md, and design-templates/html-ppt/templates/full-decks/course-module/style.css.

The root project is Apache-2.0; the HTML-PPT template package is MIT (Copyright 2026 lewis). Both license texts are included. This site does not run the OpenDesign app or daemon.
